description: JavaCPP provides efficient access to native C++ APIs from Java by generating JNI bindings at build time, exploiting the syntactic and semantic similarities between the two languages to support features like overloaded operators, templates, callbacks, and smart pointers. It serves as the foundation for the JavaCPP Presets project, which ships ready-to-use Java interfaces for native libraries such as OpenCV, FFmpeg, TensorFlow, and CUDA.
